Name: k's Genderbent Dialogue
Author: knst0
Description:
Turns selected NPCs into women at the game-data level. It flips the gender field in Data/Characters and rewrites gendered dialogue, marriage dialogue, events, mail, festival lines, and how other NPCs refer to them — to feminine, for English and Russian. No sprites or portraits are touched, so pair it with your favourite portrait/sprite mod.

[b]Characters[/b]

[list]
[*]Sebastian[/*]
[*]Shane[/*]
[*]Harvey[/*]
[*]Alex[/*]
[*]Elliott[/*]
[*]Sam[/*]
[/list]
[b]How to use[/b]

Unzip into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder and launch through SMAPI. Open Generic Mod Config Menu and enable the characters you want. Changes apply immediately.

[b]Compatibility[/b]

Data-only Content Patcher edits, so it stacks cleanly with portrait/sprite mods and most other content. When two included characters share a scene, a shared patch makes both flip correctly when both are enabled.

[b]Notes / limits[/b]

[list]
[*]Text is regendered for English and Russian only; in other languages only the Gender field changes.[/*]
[*]No textures — bring your own portrait/sprite mod.[/*]
[*]Player-gender tokens (his/her depending on your farmer) are left untouched.[/*]
[/list]
